metadata.question: Did the inundation region in Texas (specifically within a 4km radius around coordinates 29.956182, -96.111167) increase on May 28, 2016, compared to May 4, 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare flood/water extent between two dates: May 4, 2013 and May 28, 2016 - Location: Texas, 4km radius around 29.956182, -96.111167 - Best datasets: Sentinel-1 SAR for flood detection (but starts 2014), or optical indices like NDWI/MNDWI from Landsat - Since 2013 is needed, must use Landsat (Landsat 7 or 8) - For 2016, can use Landsat 8 or Sentinel-1 2. Masking strategy: - For optical (Landsat): mask clouds, calculate water indices (MNDWI or NDWI) - For SAR (Sentinel-1): use VV polarization to detect water (low backscatter) - Given the question is about inundation (flooding), SAR would be better but not available for 2013 - Will use Landsat with MNDWI for both dates 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: - Valid Zero: legitimate decrease or no water detected - C1: No images found for either date - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after cloud masking - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - Compare water area (pixel count where MNDWI > 0) between dates ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-96.111167, 29.956182]); const roi = point.buffer(4000); // 4km radius const date1 = '2013-05-04'; const date2 = '2016-05-28'; // 2. Data Acquisition // For 2013: Use Landsat 7 or 8 (L8 launched Feb 2013) let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(ee.Date(date1).advance(-7, 'day'), ee.Date(date1).advance(7, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); if (col1.size().getInfo() === 0) { // Fallback to Landsat 7 col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(ee.Date(date1).advance(-7, 'day'), ee.Date(date1).advance(7, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); } let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(ee.Date(date2).advance(-7, 'day'), ee.Date(date2).advance(7, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2013 Images: ${size1}, 2016 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('No images found for one or both dates.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate MNDWI for water detection function addMNDWI(image) { // MNDWI = (Green - SWIR1) / (Green + SWIR1) const green = image.select('SR_B3').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const swir = image.select('SR_B6').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const mndwi = green.subtract(swir).divide(green.add(swir)).rename('MNDWI'); // Cloud masking const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); return mndwi.updateMask(qaMask); } const img1 = col1.map(addMNDWI).median().clip(roi); const img2 = col2.map(addMNDWI).median().clip(roi); // Check for valid pixels const count1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); const count2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels - 2013: ${count1}, 2016: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculate water area (MNDWI > 0 indicates water) const water1 = img1.gt(0); const water2 = img2.gt(0); const waterArea1 = water1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); const waterArea2 = water2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`Water pixels - 2013: ${waterArea1}, 2016: ${waterArea2}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (waterArea1 === null || waterArea2 === null || isNaN(waterArea1) || isNaN(waterArea2)) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Inundation change: ${waterArea2 - waterArea1} pixels`); if (waterArea2 > waterArea1) { console.log('Inundation increased in 2016.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Inundation did not increase in 2016.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
